en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a riverside town with several multi‑storey buildings along a stone embankment and a steep rocky hill behind them. On top of the hill stands a large villa or small palace-like house, and further right is a smaller towered building. In the foreground a side‑wheel river steamer named "JOHN PENN" travels along the river. The title "Meissen‑R." is printed at the top left in red, and there is a red publisher's line near the bottom center.
